name: SKYPASS Select Visa Signature® Credit Card

localized_names.en: SKYPASS Select Visa Signature® Credit Card

apr.notes: APR not stated on product page; see Cardmember Agreement for current rates.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

base_rate.description: 1X mile on all other eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles awarded to primary cardmember SKYPASS account. 10,000 Bonus Miles at renewal after $35,000 in spend annually; 5,000 Bonus Miles after spending $15,000 annually.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 Bonus Miles when you spend $5,000 in eligible purchases within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: 5% off Korean Air tickets
benefits.description: Save 5% on Korean Air tickets 2X yearly, available for you and a companion.

benefits.title: $200 annual travel credit
benefits.description: Get a $200 statement credit on travel purchases annually.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck or Global Entry fee credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee statement credit.

benefits.title: 2 Korean Air Lounge vouchers each year
benefits.description: Two complimentary Korean Air Lounge vouchers each year.

benefits.title: Priority Pass Select membership
benefits.description: Priority Pass Select with four free lounge visits each year.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation/Trip Interruption Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement for the non-refundable cost of your fare when your plans change.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement for expenses incurred when your trip is delayed 12+ hours due to a covered hazard.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Get insurance coverage for car rentals made with your Visa card.
